TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION:
local rep_count = MTG():GetActionRepCount() if rep_count == 0 then ------------------------------- -- 1) ASK FIRST SCRY QUESTION ------------------------------- local scry_value = 1 -- Fill InputDC with top N cards of library local cards_found = 0 local scryDC = EffectDC():Make_Chest(0) local scryInputDC = scryDC:Make_Chest(0) for i=0,scry_value-1 do local card = EffectController():Library_GetNth(i)
if card ~= nil then scryInputDC:Set_CardPtr(cards_found, card)
cards_found = cards_found + 1 end end
if cards_found == 0 then -- No cards in library, end return false end
-- If scrying a single card, multiple choice it if scry_value == 1 or cards_found == 1 then local effectController = EffectController() if effectController ~= nil then effectController:BeginNewMultipleChoice() effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE_TOP" ) effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE_BOTTOM", TRANSITION_BOTTOM_OF_LIBRARY ) effectController:AskMultipleChoiceQuestion( "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE_QUESTION", EffectController():Library_GetTop() ) end return true end local scryTopDC = scryDC:Make_Chest(1)
-- If scrying more than 1 card, we need a browser if cards_found > 1 then -- Ask query EffectController():SetItemCount( cards_found )
for i=0,cards_found-1 do EffectController():SetItemPrompt( i, "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_TOP" ) end
EffectController():ChooseItemsFromDC( scryInputDC, scryTopDC, QUERY_FLAG_UP_TO + QUERY_FLAG_ORDERED_SELECTION ) end return true elseif rep_count == 1 then ------------------------------- -- 2) MOVE THE CARDS ------------------------------- local scryDC = EffectDC():Get_Chest(0) -- Get old chests, and determine actual scry value local scryInputDC = scryDC:Get_Chest(0) local scry_value = scryInputDC:Count() if scry_value == 1 then local answer = EffectController():GetMultipleChoiceResult() if answer == 0 then -- Scryed the single top card to top, nothing to do end if answer == 1 then -- Scry the top card to the bottom scryInputDC:Get_CardPtr(0):PutOnBottomOfLibrary() end else
local scryTopDC = scryDC:Get_Chest(1) local scry_top = scryTopDC:Count() if scry_value > 1 and scry_top < scry_value then -- Fill SecondInputDC with everything in InputDC not in TopDC ("what's left") for i=0,scry_value-1 do local card = scryInputDC:Get_CardPtr(i)
for j=0,scry_top-1 do if card == scryTopDC:Get_CardPtr(j) then -- chosen, ignore card = nil break end end
-- if not present in TopDC, move it to the bottom if card ~= nil then card:PutOnBottomOfLibrary() end end
-- Move chosen cards to top of library so first -- card chosen ends up on top of the library for i=0,scry_top-1 do local card = scryTopDC:Get_CardPtr(i)
if card ~= nil then card:PutOnTopOfLibrary() end end end end -- END return false end
